gbm_population_evidence.quote: including, but not limited to, infant-type hemispheric glioma, gliosarcoma, intracranial sarcoma and WHO Grade II ependymoma.

gbm_population_flag.reason: Gliosarcoma is named only as one example of eligible malignant brain tumours (mainly paediatric); conditions list only paediatric brain tumour.

candidate_evidence.quote: Universal Donor (UD) Transforming growth factor beta imprinting (TGFβi) Natural Killer (NK) Cells

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Participants must have a histologically-confirmed recurrent or progressive malignant brain tumor

agents.agent_name_registered: Universal Donor (UD) Transforming growth factor beta imprinting (TGFβi) Natural Killer (NK) Cells

role_evidence.quote: The TGFβi NK cell product will be manufactured in the Cell Therapy Laboratory at Nationwide Children's Hospital and given via infusion.

agents.drug_class_hint: allogeneic ex vivo expanded TGF-beta-imprinted NK cell therapy, intratumoral via Ommaya reservoir

coder_notes: Cell therapy only, so no pharmacological candidate. Population is mostly paediatric malignant brain tumours (age 1-39); gliosarcoma is an example in inclusion criterion 1. Exploratory TCR repertoire and NK persistence measures exist but the only agent is a cell therapy, so target engagement coded no.
